summary: Entravision Communications filed an 8-K reporting the mutual termination of a Cooperation Agreement with stockholders Alexandra Seros and related trusts, originally entered in May 2023. The agreement had governed director nominations and stock ownership commitments. No financial terms, consideration, or voting blocks were involved. The termination is a routine governance event, with the nominated director remaining on the board. There is no transaction, activist campaign, or capital return; this is an ordinary contractual termination with no special-situation implications.
